verdicts.reason: A keeps the circle-and-shoe artwork together, and its headline reads cleanly from left to right as the clear focal point. However, 'Full review inside.' is a tiny three-line stack jammed against the right edge and touching the circle, and the NEW VIDEO badge is shrunk and tucked under the logo. B breaks the key image apart: the lime circle sits on its own as an empty blob, while the shoe is pushed out to the far right edge and is cut off and partly covered by the badge. B's headline is also small and leaves a dead gap in the middle.
